_sobre: Format example of the typing terminal, with no brand: 16:9 in the 'coluna' layout (each command's caption in a large column on the left, the window on the right), three short commands at a fast pace, the window slowly coming closer (camera), the closing with the logo alone. The recording (example-column/terminal.json) is the real output of the placeholder commands in example-column/commands.json. Greys, placeholder commands and captions and the placeholder logo stand for the person's brand and content: swap them. Render: node scripts/example-fonts.mjs <output>/.work-typing-terminal-example-column && node templates/typing-terminal/render.mjs templates/typing-terminal/example-column.json --out <output> --mode final
